Run the organisation, not a collection of apps

Disconnected spreadsheets, manual handoffs, and delayed reports cost growing organisations time, money, and control. Kraal Code replaces fragmentation with one connected system.

◎

One source of operational truth

Every transaction, approval, and record lives in one governed environment. No more reconciling five spreadsheets to find out what actually happened.

⊘

Controlled approvals and accountability

Role-based permissions, approval workflows, and an immutable audit trail mean every action has an owner and every change leaves a trace.

◉

Real-time visibility across locations

See what is happening across branches, warehouses, projects, and field teams from one dashboard — without waiting for end-of-month reports.

◈

Faster, cleaner financial operations

Double-entry accounting, automated postings, bank reconciliation, and multi-currency support keep your books accurate and your close cycle short.

Your organisation travels with you

Kraal Code gives authorised people controlled access from a laptop at headquarters, a phone in the field, a tablet in a warehouse, or a home office in another city.

From a phone in the field

Built for how African organisations actually work

Kraal Code was designed from the ground up for the operating realities of East and Central African businesses — not adapted from a template built for another market.

  • Multi-branch and distributed operations Manage inventory, approvals, and reporting across multiple locations, cities, and countries from one platform.
  • Field and mobile work Record transactions, capture attendance, submit reports, and approve requests from a phone — even with intermittent connectivity.
  • Local currencies, tax, and payroll UGX-denominated pricing. Multi-country statutory compliance for Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, and Rwanda. EFRIS, MTN MoMo, and Airtel Money integrations.
  • Usable without weeks of training Designed so any employee can complete core tasks on their first day — enforced by an 85% unassisted task success target.
  • Support grounded in the region Implementation and support from a team that understands local business practices, regulatory requirements, and operating constraints.

Security that enables your operations

Security and privacy are not afterthoughts — they are what makes remote work, branch operations, and cloud access possible without abandoning accountability.

⬡

Tenant isolation

Every organisation's data is isolated at the database level. Cross-tenant access is prevented by design.

⬢

Role-based access control

Unlimited roles with granular permissions, branch restrictions, and approval limits control who can see and do what.

◈

Immutable audit trail

Every action is recorded in an INSERT-only log with 7-year retention. No one can alter or delete the record.

◇

AES-256 encryption

Sensitive data — salary, bank accounts, national IDs — is encrypted at rest. All traffic uses TLS 1.3.

⬡

Multi-factor authentication

TOTP-based two-factor authentication and biometric login protect account access.

⬢

OWASP Top 10 mapped

Security architecture is designed against all ten OWASP Top 10 (2021) categories with specific controls.
